chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) [which is a section of the sermon that begins: 'All praise is for Allah, from whose mercy one is not hopeless,' and it contains eleven exhortations]
ai.seo_question: What is the opening phrase of the Sermon of the Transient Nature of the World in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This header introduces a pivotal section of the famous 'Sermon of the Transient Nature of the World' (Khutbah al-Dunya), which is widely regarded as one of the most eloquent and philosophically profound discourses in Nahj al-Balagha. By noting the eleven specific points of advice, it highlights the structured rhetorical approach Imam Ali (AS) uses to guide believers from worldly attachment to spiritual readiness, a theme central to Shia ethical theology.
